notes.title: 0.8.5 Update
notes.content:
0.8.5 Update
Thanks for your support. Based on your feedback, this update is as follows
[list]
[*] Fix UI occlusion
[*] Optimize the construction node, which is easier to build (may cause problems in saving some maps before)
[*] Improve the happiness of tourists
[*] Language can be selected in the main interface
[/list]
